title: Encrypted Client Hello decryption using new SSLKEYLOGFILE secrets
description:
Implementation of Encrypted Client Hello decryption and reconstruction of the corresponding TLS session.
Adds relevant HPKE routines, verifies acceptance through magic bytes in ServerHello random and correctly processes HRR.
Uses ECH_CONFIG and ECH_SECRET from SSLKEYLOGFILE according to draft-ietf-tls-ech-keylogfile.

Relevant patch already submitted to Mozilla's NSS with other ECH supporting TLS libraries to follow.

Sample PCAPs and sslkeylogfile are available at https://github.com/yaroslavros/ech-keylog-pcaps
